title: fix(service-datasource)!: the datasource admin doors store ssl, autoConnect and description instead of dropping them, and refuse an inline ssl.key
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGrPzJx6uT5fAt6Ykpfm9uJ)_

Part of #28633 (the card stays open for its read-path follow-up, which closes it)

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — measured, not the claim's expected `no`: `POST /api/v1/datasources` and `PATCH /api/v1/datasources/NAME` now store `ssl`, `autoConnect` and `description` (accepted and dropped before), `GET /api/v1/datasources/NAME` serves them (three new answer members), `POST /api/v1/datasources/test` hands the draft's `ssl` to the probe, and the exported `DatasourceDraft`, `StoredDatasource`, `ProbeInput` and `ConnectivityBearingFields` types gain those members. The `(narrowing)` arm: one body that used to answer 201 / 200 (its whole `ssl` block silently dropped) is now refused with `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`: an `ssl` block that carries a client private key (`ssl.key`). No new error code.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx` (the TLS bullet says the Setup doors store the block and refuse `key`); no page under `skills/**` teaches the admin request body.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at the datasource admin doors (`@objectstack/service-datasource`): an inline `ssl.key` is refused.

**Built on PR #28632** (same file, landed as `819b1017`): this branch started from its head `f1438f52` and has merged `origin/main` since, so the diff is only this change.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据源管理接口的创建、编辑和连接测试，现在保留 `DatasourceSchema` 声明的所有顶层键（`ssl`、`autoConnect`、`description` 以前被悄悄丢掉）。保留哪些键在运行时直接从 schema 读出，不再有手写清单；`origin` 和 ADR-0010 保护字段（`_lock*` 等）仍由服务端决定，不从请求体取。连接测试用的是保存时会存的同一份记录，所以测试也走同样的 TLS。编辑 `ssl` 会重建连接。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28633：带 TLS 设置创建数据源，接口回 201，但存下来的记录没有 `ssl`，实际连接不加密，也没有任何提示。
- **风险与回滚**：新增一个拒收：`ssl.key`（客户端私钥）在三个入口都被拒（400，点名不回显值），因为这个入口没有加密存放它的通道，存下来就是明文。这是一个需要您确认的取舍，见下方 Acceptance notes 第一条。读取时永不返回已存的私钥；编辑时原样回传 `ssl` 会保留已存的私钥。控制台、`packages/client`、CLI 都不发送这三个键。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts`（`storedDatasourceKeys`、`toRecord`、编辑合并、`inlineSslKeyRefusal`、`getDatasource`）；`src/__tests__/datasource-admin-declared-keys-kept.test.ts`；`src/datasource-admin-plugin.ts`（探测把 `ssl` 交给驱动工厂）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/datasource-admin-declared-keys-kept.test.ts` → 18/18 通过。
- **需要你做的**：决定 `ssl.key` 的处理（推荐：先拒收，等有加密通道再开放）；其余席位落地（收窄需先过合约评审）。

## What changes

**One projection, derived from the schema** (`datasource-admin-service.ts`). The hand list in `toRecord` (`name`, `label`, `driver`, `schemaMode`, `config`, `external`, `pool`, `active`) becomes `storedDatasourceKeys()`: every key of `DatasourceSchema.shape` read at run time, minus the keys the door deliberately does not take from the body, each named with its reason:

- `origin` — the schema's own words: "server-managed, read-only", "never accepted from client input". The door stamps `runtime`, as before.
- the ADR-0010 protection envelope, read off `MetadataProtectionFields` (`_lock`, `_lockReason`, `_lockSource`, `_lockDocsUrl`, `_provenance`, `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`) — set by a code package's loader only. The metadata save door refuses an authored lock for exactly this reason (ADR-0010 §3.5, `authoredLockFamilyRefusal`), so storing them here would be the way around that door. The seat asked to include them if the schema derivation covers them; it does, and this is the reason they are left out.

So the stored set at this head is `name`, `label`, `driver`, `config`, `pool`, `ssl`, `description`, `active`, `autoConnect`, `schemaMode`, `external`. A key the schema declares later is stored the day it lands.

- **Create** stores `toRecord(input)`. **Edit** merges every patched key under the same set (`name` never, `external` keeps its `credentialsRef` rule). The record judgement on an edit now runs whenever the patch touches a key other than `label` / `active` (the two documented exemptions), so an `ssl` edit is judged by the schema's strict `ssl` shape before it is stored; a `description` / `autoConnect` edit is judged too.
- **Test door** builds one `draft = toRecord(...)` and both judges and probes it: `ProbeInput` gains `ssl`, and the plugin's probe hands it to `factory.create` (`datasource-admin-plugin.ts`), as the saved datasource's connect does through `toSpec` (`ssl: record.ssl`).
- **Live connection.** `datasourceConnectivityChanged` now compares `ssl` (`toSpec` reads it), so an edit that changes the TLS block rebuilds the pool; a `description` edit does not.
- **Read.** `getDatasource` serves `ssl` (without `key`), `autoConnect` and `description`.
- **`ssl.key`.** `inlineSslKeyRefusal` refuses a body whose `ssl` carries `key`, on create and edit (throw, `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`, under the door's existing headings) and on the test door (`ok: false`, like its other record refusals, nothing probed). The message names `ssl.key`, never the value. A stored key (a row written by another door) is withheld on read, and an edit that sends back the served block keeps it (`restoreRedactedConfig`'s rule, applied to the one withheld member).

## Tests

New `src/__tests__/datasource-admin-declared-keys-kept.test.ts`, same harness as #28607 / #28632 (real routes over `HonoHttpServer`, real `DatasourceAdminService` on in-memory stores, `entitled-caller.fixture`), recording the stored record, the record handed to `registerPool` / `reregisterPool`, and the probe input; one case drives the real `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin` probe over a fake driver factory and reads the spec handed to `factory.create`.

- **Create**: `ssl` + `autoConnect` + `description` → 201, all three stored, the record handed to `registerPool` carries `ssl`; a `GET` returns them; an unknown `ssl` member (`insecure`) is refused (400 `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`, nothing stored).
- **Edit**: `ssl` stored and the pool rebuilt from a record carrying it; `autoConnect` / `description` stored.
- **Test door**: the probe receives the draft's `ssl`; the plugin probe hands it to the driver factory.
- **`ssl.key`**: create, edit and test refuse it (status + `error.code` + `success`, or `result.ok: false`; the value absent from the raw answer; nothing stored, minted, opened or probed); a `GET` of a row already holding a key does not serve it; an edit sending back the served block keeps the stored key.
- **Controls**: a draft without these keys stores exactly `name`, `driver`, `config`, `origin` as before; `origin` is stamped `runtime` and no protection field is stored; a `description`-only edit does not rebuild the pool; a `label`-only edit leaves a stored `ssl` alone; a test draft without `ssl` probes without it. #28632's and #28607's suites (25 cases) stay green.

<details><summary>Red first, green, ablation</summary>

- **Red first** (production sources restored to `f1438f52`, #28632's head, test file kept): `Tests 12 failed | 6 passed (18)`. The six passing are the controls. The "read withholds a stored key" case is red at the base because the read serves no `ssl` at all, so it pins the served block, not a leak at the base.
- **Green** at the fix: `Tests 18 passed (18)`.
- **Ablation** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the new file plus #28632's file, 43 cases; the tests import the service and plugin from `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and run), each restore proven `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - A1 `toRecord` back to the hand list: 6 failed (create/read/ssl-judged, both probe cases, test-door key refusal).
  - A2 edit merge back to the old projection: 3 failed (ssl edit, autoConnect/description edit, key carry-forward).
  - A3 / A3b / A3c the `ssl.key` refusal removed on create / edit / test: 1 failed each, the matching refusal.
  - A4 the read serves the stored `ssl` unfiltered: 1 failed (the withheld key).
  - A5 the plugin probe stops handing `ssl` to the factory: 1 failed.
  - A6 `ssl` out of `datasourceConnectivityChanged`: 1 failed (the edit no longer rebuilds).
  - A7 the key carry-forward removed: 1 failed.
  - A8 the protection envelope taken off the server-stamped set: 1 failed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Decision: `ssl.key`** (also in the os-dev-report's `open_questions`). The card asks that a secret inside `ssl` be "redacted on read, as `config` secrets are today". Measured: this door does not store `config` secrets at all (the driver contracts refuse `config.password`; the credential goes through `secret` into the secret store and only the `credentialsRef` is stored), and the platform's datasource redaction covers `config`, not `ssl`. Storing `ssl.key` would put a private key at rest in cleartext in the datasource row, outside every redaction this package controls. This PR takes the conservative arm: refuse it at all three doors, withhold it on this door's read. Accepting it would need a spec-side change first (redaction of `ssl.key` wherever datasource rows are read, or a sealed channel for it), which is the spec lane's; the seat has the detail.
- **The protection envelope is still dropped, not refused.** Left out of the stored set by design (above). Refusing an authored lock family, as the `/meta` save door does, would be a further narrowing of this door, so it is reported rather than done here.
- **The probe still omits `pool` and `schemaMode`** from the spec it hands the factory, as before; neither changes whether or how the connection is encrypted, and the card asks for `ssl`.
- **Producers measured** (order's stop-and-report check): none relies on the drop. The Console form (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/`) sends `label`, `driver`, `schemaMode`, `config`, `external`, `secret` and never these three keys; `packages/client` has no create/update/test method; the CLI datasource commands are read-only.
- **The #28612 changeset** names `description`, `ssl` and `autoConnect` among the keys "the doors do not store"; it is not edited, and this PR's changeset carries the superseding sentence.

## Verification

All readings on head `1599499f` (the merge of `origin/main` at `68a2a216`, after #28632 landed as `819b1017`; the diff against `main` is the seven files of this change).

- **Package:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test` → Test Files 68 passed (68), Tests 1143 passed (1143). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource typecheck` exit 0; `tsc --listFiles` includes the new test file.
- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 91 families (61 before the docs line; the `drivers.mdx` edit adds the docs families), each run after a full `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (117/117) with its exit code captured before any pipe and stdin from `/dev/null`: 91 × exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first answered exit 3 (shallow clone, fixture commit absent) and exit 0 after `git fetch --depth=1` of that commit. `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 91 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- **Hand gates:** `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (1 anchored file, 2 anchors judged, 0 lost); `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-datasource` exit 0, no findings; control-byte scan of the changed files: no hits. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Full dogfood** (owed by the `!` and the `(narrowing)` arm), after the full build, under the lock, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` → Test Files 1 failed | 366 passed | 3 skipped (370), Tests 1 failed | 2965 passed | 28 skipped (2994). The one failure is not this change and is the same one #28632 recorded: `route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts` reports `runtime/route-ledger.ts: GET /packages/:id/customizations — LEDGERED BUT NOT MOUNTED`, a runtime route from #28595 (`519089e1`) on `main`. This diff touches only `service-datasource` and one docs page.
- **CI** families (Test Core incl. `test:repo`, the lint farm, the type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
